audit.why: The packet chart is Skill / Urgot x5 / Ornn, which is exactly what the seven whys strings and the early/mid/late paragraphs already describe: Urgot bullies the lane, Ornn takes over at two items on his upgrade passive and double-cast R.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two strings say Ornn's stun comes from 'E Searing Charge into a wall for the brittle stun', as if the E alone did it. wants.foe[1] repeats it.
audit.why: Brittle comes from Bellows Breath (W, 12s at rank 1) — Riot's text: 'Enemies hit by the final gout of flame become Brittle.' Searing Charge (E, 14s at rank 1, 450 range) only knocks up when Ornn collides with terrain. The stun is the two of them in order, W then E. That ordering is the whole counterplay: if you deny the W, the wall charge is just a knockup, and if you are already Brittle you must not be standing near terrain.
audit.corrected: His stun needs Bellows Breath (12s) to make you Brittle first, then Searing Charge (14s) into a wall. Break the order and there is no stun. Volcanic Rupture (Q) is 9s at rank 1 and leaves a magma pillar — that pillar is terrain he can charge into, so do not fight beside a fresh one.
